title: Nutty Malty Gooey Dutch Cookies
description: A malty, gooey hangover cure made with peanut cookies and ferment-jang. Easy to make and perfect for a satvik-friendly breakfast or brunch.

ingredients.name: peanut butter cookies
ingredients.notes: store-bought or homemade, whatever is convenient

ingredients.name: ferment-jang
ingredients.notes: available at local health food store or online

ingredients.name: brown sugar
ingredients.notes: use a good quality, organic sugar

ingredients.name: grated ginger
ingredients.notes: freshly grated for the best flavor

ingredients.name: salt
ingredients.notes: use a flaky sea salt for the best flavor

ingredients.name: milk
ingredients.notes: dairy or non-dairy, whatever you prefer

instructions: Line a 9x13-inch baking dish with parchment paper or a silicone mat.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the crushed peanut butter cookies, ferment-jang, brown sugar, grated ginger, and salt. Mix until well combined.
Add the milk and mix until a dough forms.
Drop the dough by tablespoonfuls onto the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden brown.
Remove the cookies from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes before slicing.
In a small saucepan, combine the cornstarch and a splash of milk. Whisk until smooth and add the softened butter. Whisk until combined and the butter is melted.
Pour the glaze over the warm cookies and let cool completely.
Once the cookies are cool, slice them into bars and serve.
Store leftover cookies in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days.
